title: Human clothless model?
author: JedahVoulThur
selftext:
Hi, for some time I've looking for a workflow for creating human clothless models.  
I'm not interested in creating lewd content (not judging either, just stating it isn't my goal), my goal would be something like a barbie / ken doll, a human mesh without genitals. In 3D, based on a clothed reference image, that is stylized as an anime character (I mean they don't look like real human beings).

My current workflow is creating a reference image of how the character would look in a "beach suitable attire" (I use those exact words) and the manually sculpt off the clothes using smooth brush.
The results are far from perfect, it takes a lot of time and through this workflow I can't even use the albedo (because it has the colors of the beach clothes) so I was wondering if someone know a working workflow.

It can't use local models as I don't have a computer powerful enough. I've tried multiple Stable Diffusion platforms, nanobanana, chatGPT, arena.ai, assethub and more without success. And I'm afraid that even if I get the turnaround pictures, I don't even know if 3D modeling tools like Hungyuan or Tripo accept them? What's been your experience?

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: Look into vroid you can do full doll nude. they are also full rigged characters. There are lots of turotiral how to get them into unity and unreal out there. Also how to get them into blender and edit them. There are clothing swapping tutorials too.

replies.author: JedahVoulThur
replies.body: I know about vroid and have used it in the past. Also Make Human is another alternative, but that's not the workflow I'm looking for here. I don't want to manually sculpt the mesh (only to improve details), I want it to be done through AI tools

comments.body: Isn’t that what you start with in poser 3d? And an mixamo there’s probably plenty of

replies.body: I know, but I need the model to have the exact shape of the character I'm designing
